pulse.text: Sunday-evening sweep is all market drift — **nothing new shipped** and Claude Fable 5.1 still tops the AA Index at **66**. The real mover is the year-end race: Polymarket's best-model-end-of-2026 cut Anthropic to **63%** from 66% while **OpenAI firmed to 22%**, traders giving GPT-6 Astra's first full weekend real weight; the end-of-September leg eased in sympathy to **82%** from 84% (October holds at 77%). Polymarket's OpenAI-announces-AGI market extended yesterday's snap-back upward to **24%** from 19%. On the release board the next Gemini Pro's by-Oct-31 leg firmed back to **70%**, and Grok 4.7 — which Musk now pegs at **2.1T parameters**, 40% over Grok 4.6 — still has no model card with his ~Sep 12 target under a week out (69% before Sep 21 on Manifold, before-December Grok 5 easing to 39%). Watch whether xAI actually hits that window midweek.
